questions.question: 2025 年全年销售额是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales WHERE year(order_date)=2025

questions.question: 2025 年销售额相比 2024 年同比变化了多少？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN year(order_date)=2025 THEN amount END)/SUM(CASE WHEN year(order_date)=2024 THEN amount END)-1),4) FROM sales

questions.question: 2025 年全年总销量是多少件？
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM sales WHERE year(order_date)=2025

questions.question: 2025 年客单价是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),2) FROM sales WHERE year(order_date)=2025

questions.question: 2025 年华东区销售额占总销售额的比例是多少？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN region='华东' AND year(order_date)=2025 THEN amount END)/SUM(CASE WHEN year(order_date)=2025 THEN amount END),4) FROM sales

questions.question: 2025 年销售额最高的地区是哪个？
questions.sql: SELECT region FROM sales WHERE year(order_date)=2025 GROUP BY region ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2025 年 3C数码 品类的销售额是多少元？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) FROM sales WHERE category='3C数码' AND year(order_date)=2025

questions.question: 2025 年第二季度销售额相比第一季度环比变化了多少？
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(order_date)=2 AND year(order_date)=2025 THEN amount END)/SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(order_date)=1 AND year(order_date)=2025 THEN amount END)-1),4) FROM sales
